text:
Grandma Margie’s Cookies

3/4 C shortening
1/4 C molasses
1 egg
1 C brown sugar

2 1/4 C flour
2 t baking soda
1 t ginger (dry)
1/2 t salt
1 t cinnamon
1/2 t cloves
sprinkle of black pepper (the secret ingredient!)

Preheat oven to 375.
Cream first four ingredients (shortening thru brown sugar).
Combine dry ingredients and stir into molasses mixture.
Form into small balls and roll in sugar.
Bake on greased baking sheet for 7-8 minutes.
Place baked cookies on cooling racks until cool.
Store with slice of bread to keep moist.

Yields approximately 3 dozen cookies.

Hope you enjoy :-) Josetta
